body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note:
The (If not one-of) best-run retailer in the country, still compounding at double digits with synergies to come. 

Double-digit like-for-like growth and a guided double-digit 1H27. About two-thirds of the A$100m synergy target is still to come, and the cost of doing business is falling. 

An international runway (Ireland now profitable, the UK opening) after walking away from Boots. 

Director Mario Verrocchi bought about A$5.1m of shares in September.
